refnamediv.refpurpose: filter to convert Unifont HEX fonts to BDF fonts

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: hex2bdf.pl reads a font in Unifont HEX format from its standard input and prints the font in BDF format to its standard output.

Width and height in the FONTBOUNDINGBOX are taken from the width and height given in the HEX file using the vtfontcvt1 convention. The --width and --rows command‐line options provide default width and height information if the HEX font is missing it.

The output of bdf2hex.pl1 will almost always (unless the original BDF font also lacked metadata) have height and width metadata. The HEX fonts built in Unscii have these metadata. All of the HEX fonts used in FreeBSD come with these metadata, also.
refsection.note: Using --width or --rows at this point in a chain of font conversions is usually an indication that size information has been incorrectly thrown away by an earlier tool.
refsection.para: The --copyright, --version, --variant, and --slant command‐line options provide metadata to be placed in the font properties of the BDF file. These metadata are not present in Unifont HEX files.

refsection.title: Author
refsection.para: Original tool by Roman Cyzborra and Paul Hardy, with later adaptations for Unscii by Ville-Matias Heikkilä. Further adaptations and this documentation by Jonathan de Boyne Pollard.
